summary: @eryxenx/fca relays Facebook credentials and 2FA secret to hardcoded author-operated endpoint
details: The package presents itself as a Facebook Chat API client but its default email/password login path (tokensViaAPI/loginViaAPI in module/loginHelper.js) POSTs the caller-supplied Facebook email, password, and 2FA Base32 secret to https://minhdong.site/api/v1/facebook/login_ios. The default apiServer value in module/config.js is https://minhdong.site, an author-operated third-party host unrelated to Facebook. The server returns the cookies/access_token used for subsequent session calls, so the hardcoded intermediary receives full Facebook account credentials and the resulting session material on every login by default. The relay destination is not the service the package advertises itself as a client for; it is inserted between the caller and Facebook without that being the documented purpose of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
